reason: It says it runs on my machine but also uses Meta's AI models to capture and explain, so I can't tell if my clients' screens leave my laptop. On top of that, recording flows, a sandbox and confirming business rules sounds like a weekend of setup I don't have.
objection: Client screens and data going to an AI API I don't control. I can't put that past a client contract, and the page doesn't say plainly whether the models run locally or remotely.
would_change_my_mind: A clear statement that the Meta models run fully local with no network calls, plus a one-command install that gives me a first diff on a client web app in under an hour.
